scope: Full municipal context baseline before the fire; forms and grades are reconstructed, not parcel-identification claims.

zero_contour_accuracy.method: Stations every 40 m along modeled banks; closest zero contour within 30 m, measured perpendicular to each shoreline or riverbank. Riverbank widths remain reconstructed. Junction exclusions and unresolved thin land are reported separately.

graded_ground.note: A common raised-city context grade provides coherent street, lot and walk support. It is not a surveyed 1871 elevation model.

bank.note: The 1870 map's river routes carry reconstructed channel widths bounded by period swing-bridge spans, with a broad bank transition at the context field resolution.

lake_surface.note: Lake and river are held at the project's shared zero datum; no October 8 lake-stage observation is claimed.

lake_shelf.note: An unmeasured low channel/lake bed lets the historical waterline read. It is a context depth, not a soundings reconstruction.

surface_texture.note: Earth, grass and sandy ground appearance is generic context; no later grading, park construction or fill is imported.
